comment: Universal NBAR2 application catalog. Sourcing: the applicationId layout (engine id in the top 8 bits, selector in the low 24) and the engine ids 3 (IANA-L4), 6 (USER-Defined) and 13 (PANA-L7) come from RFC 6759 section 4.1 (go/nl6/testdata/rfc/rfc6759-application-information.txt); the wire layout of every field comes from go/nl6/testdata/cisco-avc/elements.tsv. Every shipped entry uses engine 3 with the IANA port as selector, which RFC 6759 defines and which needs no Cisco protocol-pack number to verify. Cisco's PANA-L7 (engine 13) selectors are protocol-pack data nl6 has not sourced, so none are shipped; an operator catalog may carry them. Host and URI values are nl6's invention for a simulator and name no real organisation. A collector's own classification may disagree with applicationName; join on the id.
